services.name: Tickets
services.desc: The Chemainus Theatre Society is a not-for-profit organization that relies on the financial generosity of individuals and businesses. In turn, we are happy to support the fundraising efforts of other community and non-profit organizations through ticket donations. The Chemainus Theatre is pleased to provide tickets to organizations that work with individuals who face barriers to attending live theatre. These barriers can include financial, social, cultural, and/or physical. This program is made available by our Access Sponsor, BMO, and through the generous support of individuals and businesses that support our Golden Neighbour Program.
